basic_profile.bio: Living in Berlin, I'm a 41-year-old secondary school history teacher with a passion for technology and politics. My interests range from the latest tech gadgets to political discussions, and I spend my downtime exploring art and culture. I'm married with two kids and often browse Reddit in the evenings after 8 PM when the house is quiet. I enjoy discussing educational policy and frequently contribute to teacher forums.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in History and Political Science, which I leverage in my teaching career. My tech knowledge is self-taught, primarily through online courses and staying up-to-date with tech blogs and forums. I've been a tech hobbyist since my teenage years.
